HOPE, Youth Voices for Change

10 Jan 2027 - 23 Jan 2027 | West, East and North Galleries

Find Out More

Open to Public: Sunday 10 January to Saturday 23 January, 10am - 5pm 

Altered timings on: Thursday 14 January, Open to Public 10am - 1pm 

Free Admission, donations welcome

The future is here. Are you listening? 

A youth-led exhibition by national charity, Artswork

This youth-led exhibition brings together bold, honest and imaginative responses from young people to some of the most pressing challenges of our time, including: 

  • Mental health and wellbeing 
  • Climate and environmental responsibility 
  • Community cohesion and belonging 
  • Youth unemployment, skills and future opportunity 

Through visual arts, film, sound and word, Hope uses creativity as a catalyst – sparking dialogue, inviting shared responsibility and inspiring action. 

Young people are not contributing to a pre-written story. They are the authors. 

They bring insight, solutions, resilience, leadership and imagination to the table, and HOPE gives them the platform to be seen, heard and understood.  

HOPE is an exhibition by national charity Artswork, who empower children and young people through creativity. They work across England to champion youth voice, develop creative skills, and influence systems so young people can thrive.
